quotes.text:
calendar-recurrence-today = Today

# Recurrence Dialog Widget Order
# LOCALIZATION NOTE (monthly-order): Don't translate, Make sure there are no extra
# words in this property, just variables. You can change the order of below params
# Edit recurrence window -> Recurrence pattern -> Repeat monthly
# $ordinal - ordinal with article, $day - weekday
# e.g. "the First Saturday"
monthly-order = { $ordinal } { $day }

# LOCALIZATION NOTE (yearly-order-day): Don't translate, Make sure there are no extra
# words in this property, just variables. If you don't need $article in your locale
# please put this on the third place.
# Edit recurrence window -> Recurrence pattern -> Repeat yearly
# $day - day of month, $article - of, $month - month
# e.g. "6 [of] September"
yearly-order-day = { $day } { $article } { $month }

text: The recurrence Fluent strings contain only variables whose values are DOM IDs. Localization notes allow reordering and require the article placeholder in a specific position when unused. Supported component pattern: named lowerCamel object keys in JavaScript, dashed Fluent message IDs and dashed recurrence widget IDs. Translate labels through Fluent attributes, but do not translate the passed DOM IDs or add words to an order string. No repository-wide ID casing rule follows from this dialog. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Use named Fluent variables for locale-controlled widget order
